_comment: Source of truth for the music skill's en-US interaction model. This is a SEPARATE Alexa skill from the search assistant (different invocation name, different Skill ID) even though it's served by this same process at /skills/music — create it as its own skill in the Alexa Developer Console. Not served by the app — copy/paste this into that skill's JSON Editor, under the en-US locale tab. Replace invocationName with your own choice before creating the skill (Amazon's rules: no 'Alexa'/'Amazon'/'Echo', generally 2+ words). Also requires turning on the 'Audio Player' interface under the console's Interfaces tab — not something this JSON can set. Keep this in sync with music-en-IN.json — same intents/slots/samples, just duplicated per locale tab, which is how the Alexa console models multi-locale skills.
